According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman, Apple is making major changes to its retail stores in preparation for an upcoming smart home product launch. Apple is expected to release a redesigned HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K as early as this fall, but based on the related changes, it appears a third, even more important product will also be unveiled at the same time.

Apple's smart home product line has been backed up with a large number of pending launches, mainly because the company's Siri revamp has been delayed multiple times. Now that the Siri integration is finally complete, some of these products can finally see the light of day after going years without an update.

However, sources indicate that Apple will release updated versions of the HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K first, while the company's first smart home hub (also known as a HomePod or HomePad with a display) may debut a bit later.

However, based on the retail store preparations, this smart home hub may launch alongside the updated Apple TV and HomePod mini. The Power On newsletter reads as follows:

Of course, we'll have to wait until Apple's keynote in September to know for sure. But based on today's report, we may soon get our first look at Apple's all-new smart home hub, arriving alongside the new Siri AI-powered Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini.

Summary

On a side note, the rumored Apple smart home hub will reportedly feature a 7-inch square display and come in two versions: one with a built-in speaker, and another with magnets on the back for wall mounting. The product will run an entirely new operating system, with a home screen that supports widgets, can be used for FaceTime calls, and will naturally serve as the hub for all smart home accessories and Siri. It is also said to be equipped with an A18 chip.

Another new rumor on the Apple smart home product line is that the new Apple TV 4K may come with a redesigned Siri Remote, though the specific changes are unclear for now.

Are you interested in picking up any of these new smart home products? Which one are you most looking forward to? Let us know in the comments.
